propositions: Comment sync currently identifies comments by normalized body text, causing collisions on duplicate bodies and treating edits as new comments.
Identity must be a persistent HLC-timestamp-to-Jira-comment-ID map in binding_store, with write-ahead durability, replacing body-equality as the primary dedup key.
The Jira API returned comment ID from add_comment must be captured at both creation sites (create_one and update_one via _update_one_dispatch_comments) and persisted immediately.
Outbound comment bodies must be rendered through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-encode ordering, and the _resolve_codec injection must migrate from IdentityCodec to the real codec.
The inbound jira_comment_id and outbound map are authoritative for their respective directions; outbound skip logic must gate on either mapped key OR jira_comment_id presence.
Comment sync is append-only in both directions: new comments sync once, edits and deletes are never pushed or applied, and repeat reconcile passes create no duplicates.
